name: ai-accountant
description: Install ai-accountant directly from its own repository. For the whole AI Team use the HPAIF/ai-team catalog.

plugins.name: ai-accountant
plugins.description: AI Team in-house accounting & tax assistant for a founder's company: researches tax and accounting rules from official sources and re-verifies them on every use, registers every financial document, keeps an append-only financial history, runs weekly tax watch and monthly close, and improves itself from what it learns. Prepares, never files, pays or signs. Ships with an Armenia jurisdiction pack.
